passages.original: Apud Ambrosium inscribitur, De dignitate primi hominis. Apud Alcuinum autem, Dicta beati Albini Levitæ super illud Geneseos : < Faciamushominem ad imaginem et similitudinem nostram.» Paulinus Aquileiensis supra lib.
passages.english: Among the works of Ambrose it is titled "On the Dignity of the First Man." Among those of Alcuin, however, [it is titled] "Sayings of the blessed Albinus the Deacon on that [verse] of Genesis: 'Let us make man in our image and likeness.'" Paulinus of Aquileia, in the book [cited] above,
passages.notes: This is an editorial preface (Maurist/Migne style) on the manuscript attributions of the tractate. "Albinus" is Alcuin's byname. The sentence is cut off at "supra lib." and continues in the following context ("de Salutaribus Documentis", i.e. the Liber exhortationis / On Salutary Teachings, chs. 1 and 3, from which Paulinus borrowed some material). "supra lib." is read as "in the book [cited] above". The phrase could also be the start of "in the book On Salutary Teachings" with "supra" referring back to an earlier mention; the sense is uncertain. "Faciamushominem" is a scanning error, read as "Faciamus hominem".
